\section{Samples}
Sample A has a thickness of 12 $\mu$m. Sample B has a thickness of 15 $\mu$m. Sample C has a thickness of 9 $\mu$m.

\section{Results}
Sample A produced the highest signal. Sample B was stable. Sample C was the control.

\section{Conclusion}
The order Sample A, Sample B, Sample C is retained in the analysis.
